title: Pre-boot RCE in EDK II PXE driver
description: CVE-2026-97631 is a vulnerability in the EDK II PXE driver related to pre-boot remote code execution. The description and details are limited, with no CVSS score or exploit reports available. The affected versions include exactly version 3.0 and the edk2 version of the product. No patch or remediation information is provided, and no known exploits in the wild have been reported.
